# KeyStep 37 MIDI round-trip test capture
# Date: 2026-09-20
# Port: hw:0,0,0 ("Arturia KeyStep 37 MIDI 1")
# Captured with: sudo amidi -p hw:0,0,0 -d
# Context: first live verification after usbipd attach from Windows into WSL2.
# Manual key presses, pitch bend and mod wheel moves, plus panel button/knob
# presses (arp/latch controls) generating non-standard CCs 0x32/0x33/0x36.
#
# Status byte reference:
#   90 nn vv = Note On  (note nn, velocity vv)
#   80 nn vv = Note Off (note nn, velocity vv, usually 40)
#   B0 cc vv = Control Change (cc=01 is standard mod wheel; cc=32/33/36 are
#              vendor-specific — not in the standard MIDI CC table, worth
#              correlating against firmware panel-scan code)
#   E0 lsb msb = Pitch Bend
